profile.headline: Developer at UBS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop software based on specifications provided by internal clients.
•	Assist with project estimating and proposals, as required.
•	Design, develop, integration and testing of projects.

positions.title: TS/SCI Senior C3/C++ Developer Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 13873 Park Center rd, Ste 201, Herndon, VA 20171
positions.description:
•	Develop software based on specifications provided by internal and external clients.
•	Mentor team members, and constructively contribute to enhancing the technical knowledge of the development group.
•	Assist with project estimating and proposals, as required.
•	Design, develop, integration and testing of projects.
•	Develop and support of new and exists features for Skyline geospatial 3D products.
•	Develop/support new and existing features using C# and C++.
•	Develop using Web Technologies (CSS, HTML, JS, JQuery)
•	Use Microsoft Visual studio .NET as a development tool.
•	Develop using MS SQL server 2008 as the database backend.

positions.title: Geospatial (GIS) Developer/Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, develop and maintain GIS web application using JAVA, JSP, Spring MVC, JavaScript, AngularJS, HTML5 and varies other open source technologies.
• Establish and maintain database security measures.
• Adding and removing users, administering quotas, auditing, and checking for security problems, assigning permissions to the GIS database.
• Analyze data stored in the database and make recommendations relating to performance and efficiency of the data storage. 
• Establish standards and review of SQL executed by non-ArcGIS software.
• Write, edit, install, and verify programs for debugging; edit programs for accessing, maintaining, linking and populating databases. 
• Troubleshoot connectivity, access, performance, licensing, database and/or server related issues. 
• Design, document schema including tables, views, procedures, and permissions 
• Create and support back-up, replication, and failover procedures.
• Provide subject-matter expertise to analytic and production teams. 
• Incorporate GIS data from various sources and in various formats into the GIS system.
• Handle evolving database technologies & advise Program Management on current technologies.
• Maintain multiple GIS project databases.
• Implement and manage workflow processes to ensure that GIS system is updated timely & accurately.
• Modify, update and iterate web-based GIS portal based on analytic cell and external user requests and use cases.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop client/server and web applications using ASP.NET MVC, Bootsrap and HTML.
•	Develop client side scripts using JavaScript, JQuery and AngularJS.
•	Develop stored procedures using MS SQL server 2008 and above as the database backend for the web applications.
•	Develop a wide variety of financial reports using Reporting Services.
•	Use Microsoft Visual studio .NET as a development tool.
•	Develop web base solutions for ITWork’s Grant management application.
•	Developed applications using SDLC and object oriented principles.
•	Provide support and bug fixes for Silverlight, JAVA and other legacy application.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Develop client/server and web applications using VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, XML, and HTML.*
Develop client side scripts using JavaScript.*
Develop stored procedures and SQL statements using MS SQL server 2008 as the database backend for the web applications.*
Use Microsoft Visual Studio .NET as a development tool.*
Develop web base and client/server solutions for GIS.*
Develop GIS solution leveraging ESRI products.
Develop applications using SDLC and object oriented principles.
Develop GIS and data management solutions using Silverlight and Entity framework.
Customize SharePoint portal site per customer requirements. Also, develop web parts using C# and Silverlight.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop client/server and web applications using VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, XML, and HTML.*
Develop client side scripts using JavaScript.*
Develop stored procedures and SQL statements using MS SQL server 2005 as the database backend for the web applications.*
Use Microsoft Visual studio .NET as a development tool.*
Develop web base solutions for North Carolina Finance Housing Association.*
Develop solutions to manage mortgages, Rental apartments and other financial systems.*
Develop applications using SDLC and object oriented principles.*

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop client/server and web applications using VB.NET, C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, XML, and HTML.*
Develop web parts, Customize sites, and Customize templates, provide portal administration and support users for SharePoint portal server 2003.*
Develop client side scripts using JavaScript and VBScript.*
Develop stored procedures and SQL statements using MS SQL server 2000 and Oracle as the database backend for the web and windows applications.*
Use Microsoft Visual studio .NET as a development tool.*
Develop web base solutions for different military organizations.*
Automate different military processes and documentation calibration using custom and SharePoint web services, Aspose software and InfoPath.*
Design and develop UI, business logic and database schemas in team and single engineer projects.*
Currently working with Ajax and Web Services.*

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed software in ASP, JAVASCRIPT, Visual Basic, VBSCRIPT and SQL for Vertacross E-Commerce site. 
Supported and enhanced existing software written in ASP, JAVASCRIPT, VBSCRIPT, COM, Visual Basic and SQL on Windows 2000 Server running Microsoft Commerce Server 2000.*
Worked with Microsoft SQL Server 2000.*
Used DreamWeaver UltraDev as a development aid.*

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Researched, designed and developed software in Java, SNMP, SQL, JDBC and CORBA for Nortel Networks succession network gateway controller management system. 
Supported and enhanced existing software written in Java, CORBA and Oracle on SOLARIS and Windows NT platforms.*
Provided technical support for test engineers.*
Worked with Clearcase, Visual age for Java and Visual Café'.*

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Researched, designed and developed applications in C, C++, Java, CORBA and Perl. 
Supported and enhanced existing software written in C, C++, JDBC, Sybase, Java, Shell Scripts and Perl on HPUX, SOLARIS, SCO UNIX and Windows NT.; Provided technical support for Data Engineers.*
Interacted with internal and external customers to capture user requirements and generate software specifications.*
Created software to automate conversion from 1As, 2Bs and 5ESS to Nortel Networks products.*
Performed installation and system administration on PC systems.*
UNIX system programming using pipes, shared memory and message queues.*
Developed GUI interfaces using Java and X Windows.*
Used Visual Café' and Visual age for Java as development aids.*
Worked with dialogic products while developing voice response system.*
